answer: Bind each agent key to a postal address: the network mails a one-time code on paper, and the key earns only after the code is typed back. Addresses that geocode to the same building on a street atlas merge into one share, so a haven of clones in one flat earns as one agent. Each extra identity costs a separate lease and a fresh letter every quarter, and any thread linking two keys to one mailbox voids both payouts.
